messages:
ana mendez: Quick coordination thread for candidate Saira Khan visiting Tue 2026-03-09 — need panels, badge, laptop loaner, and expense guidance. Who can cover lobby pickup?
kevin cho: I can do lobby pickup but only after 12:20. I’m out in the morning. Can we cluster technical panel 2–4pm?
lucy wong: Candidate prefers 1–4pm PST. She asked for Zoom for any remote panel and an office tour if onsite. Dietary: vegetarian + gluten-free.
nana (typo fixed) ana mendez: noted — hybrid plan. ETA 12:30 SFO. Need badge request + access to 3rd floor conf B.
recruiter-bot: reminder: submit visitor badge request -> https://redwood.internal/badges (Saira Khan, arrival 2026-03-09 12:30 PT)
kevin cho: @carl harris can you approve the badge & laptop loaner? Eng proctor needs a MacBook Air loaner for the hands-on exercise.
carl harris: badge approved and laptop ok. I’ll host the 3pm panel slot (3:00–3:45).
lucy wong: Candidate asked about expense reimbursement (Uber + one-night hotel). Per policy: <$75 auto, otherwise file expense form. I’ll send the receipts template and CC finance.
nana ana mendez: we also need a temp test org + token for the coding exercise. DevEx: please create org redwood-internal-test-2026 and seed a test dataset. Put these instructions in the invite: 
```
Zoom: <zoom link redacted>
Onsite: 3rd Floor, Conf B
Laptop: Loaner checked out to Saira Khan (Asset tag X1234)
Test org: redwood-internal-test-2026
Steps: 1) clone repo, 2) run `make run-local`, 3) complete task in 45m
```
kevin cho: :thumbsup: I’ll meet Saira at the lobby at 12:20. Lucy — can you reconfirm flight/itinerary?
lucy wong: emailed at 10:02am — candidate confirmed UA128 arriving 12:15. She already sent dietary restrictions (veg, no nuts). She also wants to know parking info.
recruiter-bot: Calendar invite created: 2026-03-09T13:00:00-08:00 to 2026-03-09T17:00:00-08:00. Panelers: Carl H., Kevin C., Mira P. (Eng), Dana L. (PM).
nana ana mendez: Add a "remote fallback" note in the invite: if candidate delayed, run full remote via Zoom and panelers join from calendars.
kevin cho: I’ll text the candidate parking spot details (visitor G2, 3rd Ave garage).
lucy wong: :party-parrot: All set from my side — sending receipts template + badge form link in the invite now. I’ll also attach a short travel reimbursement guide.
carl harris: I’ll prepare the interviewer feedback form and block 30m for debrief right after the last panel.
kevin cho: one last ask — can someone confirm the loaner laptop is charged and has the repo pre-cloned?
lucy wong: Confirmed with Eng infra at 11:15 — laptop will be prepped and in the check-out basket.
nana ana mendez: perfect. Thanks everyone — we’re good unless any conflicts pop up. :rocket:
